repo_notes.content: Unofficial shell-script toolchain (fork lineage: telnetdoogie-labs <- markdumay/synology-docker) to update Docker Engine and Docker Compose on Synology NAS beyond what DSM's Container Manager ships. Repeatable, reversible, with built-in rollback.
High-level flow: download official Docker + Compose binaries -> back up existing install -> stop Docker safely -> replace binaries/config -> restart. Rollback restores the backup.

Escape hatch for Synology's legacy 'db' log driver — Portainer persists the original logging driver per container, so 'db'-created containers stay broken after upgrade and must be recreated with 'local'.

Not supported by Synology: after upgrading, the Container Manager UI no longer works reliably for managing containers or logs. Requires SSH + sudo. Nvidia runtime users must re-run nvidia-ctk runtime configure or restart the driver after the script.
See README.md for the full step-by-step usage, warnings, and DSM version guidance.
